questions.prompt: Do you work or are you a student?

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Occupation
sentenceStarters: I've been in this role for...

questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I am a student. I study English at a college. It is, um, a small college. I hope to get a good job after I finish. It is very hard.
questions.sampleBand6: I'm currently a student. I'm actually working towards a degree in Marketing. It's quite challenging, but I'm really enjoying it. I'm hoping it will open up more opportunities for me in the future. I mean, it's a competitive field.
questions.sampleBand7: At the moment, I'm a full-time student. I'm studying architecture, which is incredibly demanding, but also really rewarding. It's a steep learning curve, and I'm constantly learning new things. Hopefully, all the hard work will pay off when I graduate and start my career.
questions.sampleBand8: I'm currently enrolled as a student at the local university. I'm majoring in environmental science, which is a field I'm genuinely passionate about. To be honest, the workload can be quite intense at times, but I'm finding the subject matter deeply fascinating. I'm hoping to go on to postgraduate study after I finish my bachelor's degree, possibly specializing in conservation.
questions.sampleBand9: I'm a student, pursuing a Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence. It’s a rapidly evolving field, and I find myself constantly challenged and stimulated. While the course is demanding, requiring a significant amount of dedication and research, I believe it's a worthwhile investment in my future. My ambition is to contribute to the development of ethical and beneficial AI applications, making a real difference in the world. Ultimately, I see myself at the cutting edge of innovation.
questions.sampleAnswer: I'm currently working as a full-time professional in the marketing industry. I've been in this role for about two years now, and it's been a very rewarding experience so far. My daily routine involves coordinating social media campaigns and analyzing market trends.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, men talabaman. Men kollejda ingliz tilini o'qiyman. U, um, kichik kollej. O'qishni tugatgandan keyin yaxshi ish topishga umid qilaman. Bu juda qiyin.
questions.uzSampleBand6: Hozirda men talabaman. Aslida men Marketing bo'yicha daraja olishga harakat qilyapman. Bu juda qiyin, lekin menga juda yoqyapti. Kelajakda bu men uchun ko'proq imkoniyatlarni ochadi deb umid qilaman. Aytmoqchimanki, bu raqobatbardosh soha.
questions.uzSampleBand7: Hozirda men to'liq stavkali talabaman. Men arxitektura bo'yicha o'qiyapman, bu nihoyatda talabchan, lekin ayni paytda juda foydali. Bu keskin o'rganish egri chizig'i va men doimo yangi narsalarni o'rganyapman. Umid qilamanki, barcha mashaqqatli mehnatim o'qishni tugatib, kareramni boshlaganimda o'z samarasini beradi.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Men hozirda mahalliy universitetda talaba sifatida ro'yxatdan o'tganman. Men atrof-muhitshunoslik bo'yicha tahsil olyapman, bu men chin dildan ishtiyoqmand bo'lgan soha. Rostini aytsam, ba'zan yuklama juda kuchli bo'lishi mumkin, lekin men bu mavzuni juda qiziqarli deb topyapman. Bakalavr darajasini tugatgandan so'ng, magistratura bosqichida o'qishni davom ettirishga umid qilaman, ehtimol, tabiatni muhofaza qilish bo'yicha ixtisoslashaman.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Men talabaman, Sun'iy Intellekt bo'yicha magistrlik darajasini olyapman. Bu tez rivojlanayotgan soha va men o'zimni doimo qiyin va rag'batlantiruvchi vaziyatda topaman. Kurs talabchan bo'lsa-da, katta miqdordagi fidoyilik va tadqiqotni talab qilsa-da, menimcha, bu kelajagimga munosib sarmoya. Mening maqsadim - axloqiy va foydali AI ilovalarini ishlab chiqishga hissa qo'shish, dunyoda sezilarli o'zgarishlar qilish. Oxir-oqibat, men o'zimni innovatsiyalarning eng oldingi saflarida ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Hozirda men marketing sohasida to'liq stavkali mutaxassis bo'lib ishlayapman. Taxminan ikki yildan beri shu lavozimda ishlayapman va bu hozirgacha juda foydali tajriba bo'ldi. Mening kundalik ishim ijtimoiy media kampaniyalarini muvofiqlashtirish va bozor tendentsiyalarini tahlil qilishni o'z ichiga oladi.

It's not perfect, but I can't complain too much.

Plus, the company really walks the walk when it comes to employee wellbeing, so I couldn't ask for a better work environment.
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I'm very fond of my job. What I enjoy most is the creative aspect of it—being able to come up with new ideas and seeing them come to life in a project is very satisfying. Additionally, I work with a fantastic team, which makes the work environment very pleasant.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, e-e, rostini aytsam, yaxshi. Unaqa, orzudagi ishim emas. Kunimni o'tkazyapman. Ish, e-e, ba'zan zerikarli. Boshqa ish topmoqchiman.
questions.uzSampleBand6: E-e, yaxshi, deb o'ylayman. Ya'ni, dunyodagi eng qiziqarli narsa emas, lekin pul topishga yordam beradi, bilasizmi? Sekin-asta rivojlanyapman. Aslida, men bilan ishlaydigan odamlar juda yaxshi, shuning uchun bu katta ahamiyatga ega. Ba'zan borishni kutaman.
questions.uzSampleBand7: Ha, ishimni yaxshi ko'raman, aslida. Bu qiyin va men doimo yangi narsalarni o'rganyapman, bu juda zo'r. Albatta, stressli kunlar bor, lekin umuman olganda, men uni juda foydali deb bilaman. Kompaniyaning madaniyati ham juda yaxshi va men hamkasblarim bilan yaxshi til topishaman. Mukammal emas, lekin ko'p ham noliy olmayman.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Ha, ishimdan chin dildan zavqlanaman. Bu shunchaki maqsadga erishish vositasi emas; ishning o'zi menga juda yoqadi. Bundan tashqari, men kompaniyaning maqsadlariga haqiqiy hissa qo'shayotgandek his qilyapman. Albatta, unchalik yoqimli bo'lmagan jihatlar ham bor, lekin ijobiy tomonlari salbiy tomonlaridan ancha ustun. Mening ajoyib jamoam bor va men o'z mahorat va tajribam uchun qadrlanaman. Bu men biror narsa bera oladigan rol.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Rostini aytsam, ishimni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Bu har kuni ertalab boshlashga shoshib o'rnimdan turadigan rol. Ish juda foydali va men doimo o'z imkoniyatlarimni oshirishga chaqirilaman. Albatta, bosimsiz emas, lekin menda ajoyib jamoa va qo'llab-quvvatlovchi menejer bor, bu esa katta ahamiyatga ega. Men o'z sohamda haqiqatan ham o'zgarish qilyapman deb his qilyapman va bu juda mamnuniyat bag'ishlaydi. Bundan tashqari, kompaniya xodimlarning farovonligi haqida gapirganda, haqiqatan ham so'zida turadi, shuning uchun undan ham yaxshiroq ish muhitini so'ray olmasdim.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Ha, ishimni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Menga eng yoqadigan narsa - uning ijodiy tomoni—yangi g'oyalar o'ylab topish va ularning loyihada amalga oshishini ko'rish juda mamnuniyat bag'ishlaydi. Bundan tashqari, ajoyib jamoa bilan ishlayman, bu esa ish muhitini juda yoqimli qiladi.

questions.prompt: Is there anything you dislike about your job?
questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, honestly, sometimes it's a bit boring. The work is, like, the same every day. I don't like doing the same thing. It's not very interesting. I want to do other things, but I can't. It is, um, difficult work.
questions.sampleBand6: Um, actually, there are a few things. I mean, sometimes the commute is really bad. The heavy traffic in the mornings can be a real pain. And, also, I don't always get along with my colleagues. It's not a huge problem, but it can be a bit annoying sometimes, you know?
questions.sampleBand7: Well, to be honest, the most frustrating thing is probably the lack of opportunities for career advancement. I feel like I'm stuck in a rut, doing the same tasks day in and day out. Although I enjoy the work itself and the people I work with, I'm eager to move up the ladder and take on more responsibility, but it doesn't seem like there's much chance of that happening anytime soon.
questions.sampleBand8: Um, by and large, I enjoy my job. However, if I had to pick something I dislike, it would probably be the office politics. Occasionally, there's a bit of backstabbing and one-upmanship, which I find incredibly draining. I prefer a more collaborative and supportive environment. It's not a constant issue, but when it does happen, it gets me down. I try to rise above it and focus on my work, but it can be challenging.
questions.sampleBand9: Well, on the whole, I find my job quite fulfilling, but if I were to nitpick, I'd say the bureaucratic processes can be a bit tedious. There's a lot of red tape involved in even the simplest tasks, which can be incredibly time-consuming and frustrating. I understand the need for procedures, but sometimes it feels like they're designed to slow things down rather than improve efficiency. It's like trying to navigate a maze sometimes! Frankly, I think the company could benefit from streamlining some of these processes to allow us to focus on more strategic and creative work.
questions.sampleAnswer: If I had to mention something, it would be the occasional long hours during peak seasons. Sometimes we have to meet very tight deadlines, which can lead to a bit of stress. However, these periods are usually temporary, and we often have more flexibility during the quieter months.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, um, rostini aytsam, ba'zan biroz zerikarli. Ish, har kuni bir xil, uncha qiziq emas. Men bir xil narsani qilishni yoqtirmayman. Boshqa narsalarni qilmoqchiman, lekin qila olmayman. Bu, um, qiyin ish.
questions.uzSampleBand6: Um, aslida, bir nechta narsa bor. Nazdimda, ba'zan qatnov juda yomon. Ertalabki tirbandlik haqiqiy azob bo'lishi mumkin. Va, yana, men doim ham hamkasblarim bilan kelishavermayman. Bu katta muammo emas, lekin ba'zan biroz asabiylashishi mumkin, bilasizmi?
questions.uzSampleBand7: Xo'sh, ochig'ini aytsam, eng asabiylashtiradigan narsa, ehtimol, martaba o'sishi uchun imkoniyatlarning yo'qligi. Men o'zimni bir xil vazifalarni kundan-kunga bajarib, bir xil holatda qolib ketgandek his qilyapman. Garchi ishning o'zi va men ishlayotgan odamlar menga yoqsa-da, men zinapoyadan yuqoriga ko'tarilishni va ko'proq mas'uliyatni o'z zimmamga olishni xohlayman, lekin yaqin orada bunday bo'lishiga imkoniyat yo'qdek tuyuladi.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Um, asosan, menga ishim yoqadi. Biroq, agar men yoqtirmaydigan narsani tanlashim kerak bo'lsa, ehtimol bu ofis siyosati bo'lardi. Ba'zida biroz g'iybat va ustunlikka intilish bo'ladi, bu esa meni juda charchatadi. Men ko'proq hamkorlik va qo'llab-quvvatlash muhitini afzal ko'raman. Bu doimiy muammo emas, lekin bu sodir bo'lganda, bu meni tushkunlikka soladi. Men undan yuqori turishga va ishimga e'tibor qaratishga harakat qilaman, lekin bu qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Xo'sh, umuman olganda, men ishimni juda foydali deb bilaman, lekin agar men mayda narsalarni qidirishga tushsam, byurokratik jarayonlar biroz zerikarli bo'lishi mumkin derdim. Hatto eng oddiy vazifalarda ham ko'p keraksiz qog'ozbozlik mavjud, bu juda ko'p vaqt talab qilishi va asabiylashtirishi mumkin. Men tartib-qoidalarga bo'lgan ehtiyojni tushunaman, lekin ba'zan ular samaradorlikni oshirishdan ko'ra ishlarni sekinlashtirish uchun mo'ljallangandek tuyuladi. Bu go'yo labirintdan o'tishga urinish kabi! Ochig'i, menimcha, kompaniya ushbu jarayonlarning ba'zilarini soddalashtirib, bizga ko'proq strategik va ijodiy ishga e'tibor qaratishimizga imkon berishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Agar biror narsani aytishim kerak bo'lsa, bu eng band paytlarda vaqti-vaqti bilan uzoq soatlar bo'lardi. Ba'zan biz juda qisqa muddatlarga rioya qilishimiz kerak, bu esa biroz stressga olib kelishi mumkin. Biroq, bu davrlar odatda vaqtinchalik bo'ladi va bizda tinchroq oylarda ko'proq moslashuvchanlik bo'ladi.

questions.prompt: What do you like about your studies?

questions.sampleBand6: Um, what I like about my studies is probably the practical aspects. I mean, I'm studying engineering, so we get to work on real projects. It can be challenging, and I sometimes struggle a bit, but it's rewarding when you finally figure things out, you know?

Although it can be quite demanding at times, I find it immensely rewarding to get to grips with complex ideas.

Men dengiz biologiyasini o'rganyapman va okean ekotizimlari haqida bilish imkoniyati juda hayratlanarli. Bu, albatta, oson ish emas, lekin qiyinchilik meni motivatsiya qiladi va men yaxshi natijalarga erishyapti.
questions.uzSampleBand8: O'qishlarimda menga eng ko'p yoqadigan narsa, shubhasiz, intellektual rag'batlantirish. Garchi ba'zan juda talabchan bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, men murakkab g'oyalarni tushunib olishni juda foydali deb bilaman.

Hozirda men astrofizika bo'yicha diplom olmoqdaman va koinot sirlariga chuqur kirish imkoniyati, ochig'ini aytsam, orzu ushalishi. questions.uzSampleAnswer: O'qishlarimda menga eng qiziqarli tuyuladigan narsa bu biz qamrab oladigan mavzularning xilma-xilligidir. Men Biznesni boshqarishni o'rganyapman va ayniqsa tashkiliy xulq-atvor va strategik boshqaruv haqida bilish menga yoqadi. Nazariy jihatdan asosli tushunchalarni real biznes stsenariylarida qanday qo'llash mumkinligini ko'rish juda hayratlanarli.

questions.prompt: What was your dream job when you were young?

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Childhood Dreams
sentenceStarters: When I was a child, I...

questions.sampleBand5: Um, when I was young, I wanted to be a teacher. Like, a school teacher. I liked my teachers. Actually, maybe because they seemed nice. I don't know. But now, no. I don't like children so much, honestly.
questions.sampleBand6: Well, when I was a child, I think I wanted to be a vet. I really loved animals, and I thought it would be great to look after them all day. Actually, I also considered being a firefighter for a while, because they seemed very brave and did important work. But yeah, mostly a vet.
questions.sampleBand7: Growing up, my dream job was to be a fashion designer. I used to spend hours sketching clothes and imagining my own brand. Basically, I was really into art and design. Looking back, it was probably influenced by all the fashion magazines I read. However, I realised it's a very competitive industry, so I chose a different path.
questions.sampleBand8: When I was younger, I had my heart set on becoming a marine biologist. I was fascinated by the ocean and all the creatures that lived there. I imagined myself exploring coral reefs and diving into the unknown. In fact, I even volunteered at a local aquarium for a while. Ultimately, I realised that the reality of the job involved a lot more lab work and less actual diving than I'd imagined, so I changed my mind.
questions.sampleBand9: As a child, I was absolutely convinced that I would become an architect. I was captivated by the idea of designing buildings and shaping the urban landscape. I would spend hours building up elaborate structures out of Lego and sketching blueprints. In retrospect, I think it was the combination of creativity and problem-solving that really appealed to me. Moreover, I was inspired by architects like Frank Lloyd Wright, who seemed to push the boundaries of what was possible. While I didn't end up pursuing that career path, I still retain a keen interest in architecture and design.
